# ai-first-web-frame

> AI-native micro-frontend framework: a shell gateway composes Next.js pages,
> which fetch independently-deployable SSR fragments through a typed
> (Zod-schema) fragment registry. Consumers are AI agents operating the
> lifecycle CLIs, not humans reading prose — every doc below favors exact
> signatures, JSON envelopes, and copy-paste `Accept:` commands.

## Docs

This index is curated, not exhaustive: historical and proposal documents
(GAP_ANALYSIS, REMEDIATION_PLAN, AI_NATIVE_DEVX,
AI_NATIVE_PRODUCTION_READY_FRAMEWORK_PLAN, MONOREPO_DEPLOYMENT,
PERFORMANCE_BUDGET, TDD_GUIDE, AI_COMPONENT_GUIDE, docs/trade-demo/) are
deliberately unlisted — consult `docs/` directly for history.

- [docs/OPERATIONS.md](docs/OPERATIONS.md): the fragment lifecycle
  (scaffold -> implement+test -> register -> mount -> verify -> promote ->
  rollback) as exact commands, flags, and JSON result envelopes. Consult this
  first for any lifecycle operation on a fragment.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE_REFACTOR_PLAN.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE_REFACTOR_PLAN.md):
  the current structural refactor plan (package re-layering, npm
  distribution, manifest-driven composition, this documentation system).
  Consult to understand what is stable vs. actively moving before depending
  on an API.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): request flow and deployable
  unit topology (shell gateway, pages, fragments, registries). Consult for a
  map of how a request traverses the system.
- [docs/COMPONENT_CONTRACT.md](docs/COMPONENT_CONTRACT.md): the Zod schema
  set in `@mvp/contracts` and the rule that all manifests must be
  schema-validated. Consult before hand-writing any manifest or contract
  object.
- [docs/RELEASE_MODEL.md](docs/RELEASE_MODEL.md): the CI/CD release chain per
  deployable unit, with each pipeline stage marked implemented or planned.
  Consult before assuming a deployment stage exists.
- [docs/DEMOS.md](docs/DEMOS.md): the demo capability index — which of the 5
  composed pages (`apps/page-*`) proves which named capability, sourced from
  each page's `PageManifest.demonstrates` field
  (`packages/contracts/src/index.ts`). Consult to find the page that
  demonstrates a specific composition/streaming/island capability instead of
  re-deriving it from source.
- [docs/COMPOSITION.md](docs/COMPOSITION.md): slot model, render strategies
  (incl. why the retired `isr` alias is now rejected), the manifest → codegen →
  `<FragmentSlot>` pipeline, DAG/timeout/fallback execution and streaming
  semantics, and the two-tier fragment independence table (SSR-only vs.
  React-island). Consult before composing or reasoning about a page's slots.
- [docs/CONTRACTS.md](docs/CONTRACTS.md): schema index for `@mvp/contracts` —
  every exported Zod schema, grouped by concern, with the real runtime
  enforcement call site (or an honest "type-level only" marking). Consult to
  learn which boundary actually validates a given object.
- [docs/INTERACTION.md](docs/INTERACTION.md): the contract-enforced bus /
  slice store / ACL model, island snapshot handshake, and the orphan-bus
  failure mode + its audit rule. Consult before writing any `island.tsx`,
  bus publish/subscribe, or slice contract.
- [docs/DELIVERY.md](docs/DELIVERY.md): the graph-based affected model — the
  exact narrow-vs-GLOBAL seeding rules, registry-write narrowing, deploy
  gates (`pnpm verify`'s 13 gates, `verify:runtime`, E2E tiers). Consult
  before reasoning about blast radius or CI/deploy behavior.

## Package AGENT.md (stable packages; API not part of the current refactor)

- [packages/contracts/AGENT.md](packages/contracts/AGENT.md): Zod schemas for
  every framework boundary (manifests, registry, `/render`, request context,
  budgets). Consult to validate or construct any cross-boundary object.
- [packages/runtime/AGENT.md](packages/runtime/AGENT.md): page-side fragment
  slot composition/scheduling engine (`executeFragmentSlots`). Consult when
  composing a page from fragment slots and data dependencies.
- [packages/request/AGENT.md](packages/request/AGENT.md): the only
  policy-gated HTTP client for business code (`createRequestClient`).
  Consult before making any outbound API call.
- [packages/request-context/AGENT.md](packages/request-context/AGENT.md):
  builds/serializes the per-request `RequestContext` from headers. Consult at
  any request edge (page, fragment, gateway) that needs locale/tenant/user.
- [packages/observability/AGENT.md](packages/observability/AGENT.md): request
  tracing (`createRequestTrace`) and metrics (`createMetricsRegistry`) plus
  trace exporters. Consult to instrument a new code path or export traces.
- [packages/optimizer/AGENT.md](packages/optimizer/AGENT.md): turns trace
  snapshots into actionable `OptimizationFinding`s (duplicate calls,
  waterfalls, low cache hit rate, static-rendering candidates). Consult when
  investigating performance regressions or running `audit:optimizer`.
- [packages/ui/AGENT.md](packages/ui/AGENT.md): server-safe React component
  library (`AppNav`, `Button`, `Card`, `Section`, `ProductCardBase`, ...).
  Consult before building a new UI component, to reuse instead of duplicate.
- [packages/design-tokens/AGENT.md](packages/design-tokens/AGENT.md): raw
  design token values and CSS-custom-property generation. Consult for any
  color/spacing/radius/font/z-index value instead of hard-coding one.
- [packages/assets/AGENT.md](packages/assets/AGENT.md): the typed asset
  manifest model — collect/merge/de-duplicate css/js/font/theme/i18n assets
  (CSP/SRI fields preserved) and render them to HTML tag descriptors
  (`collectAssets`, `mergeAssetsWithPolicy`, `createAssetHtmlTags`). Consult
  before hand-assembling asset lists or `<link>`/`<script>` tags.
- [packages/workers/AGENT.md](packages/workers/AGENT.md): manifest-governed
  worker runtime — `WorkerManifest` validation + policy rules, the in-process
  background queue with retry/dead-letter (`createBackgroundWorker`),
  scheduled jobs, and the typed worker client/host postMessage protocol.
  Consult before running any background or browser-worker task.

## Package AGENT.md (P1-re-layered packages; domain-agnostic APIs)

- [packages/interaction/AGENT.md](packages/interaction/AGENT.md): the generic
  contract-first pub/sub bus, mutation-tag-invalidation wrapper, and
  cross-tab broadcast bridge (`createInteractionBus`, `defineMutation`,
  `createBroadcastBridge`). Consult before any cross-fragment/island
  messaging.
- [packages/data/AGENT.md](packages/data/AGENT.md): the generic cached,
  deduped, freshness-aware data client (`createDataClient`, `readData`,
  `subscribeData`). Consult when backing a fragment slot's declared data
  dependencies.
- [packages/storage/AGENT.md](packages/storage/AGENT.md): the generic
  privacy-partitioned storage facade over cookie/KV/web-storage adapters
  (`createStorage`). Consult for any persisted value instead of touching a
  storage backend directly.
- [packages/design-system/AGENT.md](packages/design-system/AGENT.md): CSS
  variable/theme emitters, base reset, and Tailwind preset built on
  `@mvp/design-tokens` (`createAllThemeVariables`, `tailwindPreset`). Consult
  before hand-writing theme CSS or a Tailwind config.
- [packages/registry/AGENT.md](packages/registry/AGENT.md): the fragment
  registry data model, atomic-write/lock/conflict utility, register/promote/
  rollback mutation logic, slot mount/drift-check, and manifest→runtime
  codegen behind the lifecycle CLIs. Consult before writing any lifecycle
  tooling or registry-adjacent script.
- [packages/routes/AGENT.md](packages/routes/AGENT.md): the static shell-
  gateway route registry and path matcher (`matchRoute`). Consult when
  resolving an incoming request path to its owning page service.
- [packages/store/AGENT.md](packages/store/AGENT.md): the generic SSR-safe
  client-side slice store built on `@mvp/interaction`
  (`createSliceStore`, `useStoreSlice`). Consult when a page needs shared
  state its islands read/write.
- [packages/islands/AGENT.md](packages/islands/AGENT.md): the generic client
  island hydration runtime, including the C2 snapshot version handshake
  (`registerIsland`, `mountIsland`, `hydrateIslands`). Consult before
  registering or hydrating any React island.

## Domain AGENT.md (demo domain layer; the reference for adding a domain)

- [domains/trade-contracts/AGENT.md](domains/trade-contracts/AGENT.md): the
  trade demo's typed interaction contracts — slice contracts, store-owner
  contract reshaping, `placeOrder`/`cancelOrder` mutations, and flow
  reducers. Consult as the reference for defining a new domain's contracts.
- [domains/trade-data/AGENT.md](domains/trade-data/AGENT.md): the trade
  demo's data-source registry, `createTradeDataClient`, and the deterministic
  mock realtime transport (seeded PRNG frame generators). Consult as the
  reference for wiring a domain's data sources onto `@mvp/data`.
- [domains/trade-prefs/AGENT.md](domains/trade-prefs/AGENT.md): the trade
  demo's persisted preferences (watchlist, recent symbols, theme/locale
  cookies, layout prefs) on `@mvp/storage`. Consult as the reference for
  domain-scoped persistence.
- [domains/trade-theme/AGENT.md](domains/trade-theme/AGENT.md): the trade
  demo's semantic colors (buy/sell/up/down) and theme-scoped CSS emission via
  `@mvp/design-system`'s public `emitDeclarations`. Consult as the reference
  for domain-owned, theme-aware tokens.
- [domains/trade-chart/AGENT.md](domains/trade-chart/AGENT.md): the trade
  demo's canvas chart renderer (demo-only presentation code). Consult as the
  reference for domain-layer presentation utilities.

## Tooling AGENT.md (scaffolder, audits, dev/release tooling, MCP server)

- [packages/mcp/AGENT.md](packages/mcp/AGENT.md): the dependency-free MCP
  stdio server exposing this framework's discovery (`query_registry`,
  `affected_units`) and lifecycle tools (scaffold/register/mount/promote/
  rollback) as agent-callable tools, wrapping the same `scripts/*.mts` CLIs.
  Consult before connecting an agent to this repo over MCP instead of
  shelling out to the lifecycle CLIs directly.
- [tools/create-component/AGENT.md](tools/create-component/AGENT.md): the
  fragment/UI scaffolder (`docs/OPERATIONS.md` step 1) — exact file lists per
  `--type`, the generated layoutHint skeleton, and collision/`--force`
  behavior. Consult before hand-writing a fragment or UI component skeleton
  instead of scaffolding it.
- [tools/_shared/AGENT.md](tools/_shared/AGENT.md): the shared source library
  behind every `tools/*` audit/scaffolder (not a workspace package) — CLI
  flag parsing, pass/warn/fail + exit-code math, the per-unit `budget.ts`
  loader, similarity math, fs walking, and the comment/string-stripping code
  heuristics. Consult before writing or modifying any audit tool.
- [tools/bundle-budget-check/AGENT.md](tools/bundle-budget-check/AGENT.md):
  the `pnpm audit:bundle` gate — page first-load JS (gzipped, from `.next`
  manifests, failing loudly when unbuilt) and fragment client JS (minified
  esbuild bundle, shared vendor external) vs each unit's `src/budget.ts`
  ceilings, with explicit `unmeasured` rows. Consult before reasoning about
  or fixing a JS budget failure.
- [tools/component-similarity-check/AGENT.md](tools/component-similarity-check/AGENT.md):
  the `pnpm audit:similarity` gate — fingerprints `packages/ui` + fragment
  `.tsx` component sources and fails any pair scoring ≥ 0.82 on the weighted
  name/props/tokens/JSX dimensions. Consult when the audit flags a
  near-duplicate (reuse the flagged component instead).
- [tools/css-budget-check/AGENT.md](tools/css-budget-check/AGENT.md): the
  `pnpm audit:css` gate — per-unit `cssBytes` ceilings vs the unit's own
  minified source CSS, plus global hygiene metrics (unused/duplicated rules,
  global selectors, `!important`). Consult before reasoning about or fixing
  a CSS budget failure.
- [tools/dependency-audit/AGENT.md](tools/dependency-audit/AGENT.md): the
  `pnpm audit:deps` gate — duplicated dependency versions, cross-page /
  fragment→page imports, raw `fetch(` in business code, browser globals in
  server-safe packages, client-only leakage, the packages→domains layering
  rule, and the island orphan-bus rule (comment/string-stripped heuristics).
  Consult before adding dependencies or unusual imports.
- [tools/dev-harness/AGENT.md](tools/dev-harness/AGENT.md): the
  `pnpm dev:component` single-fragment harness (not a workspace package) —
  `describeMockWorld` (manifest → seed/mock/inject/observe spec) and the
  `layoutHint`-sized themed preview page. Consult to run one fragment in
  isolation with its contract-mocked world.
- [tools/optimization-audit/AGENT.md](tools/optimization-audit/AGENT.md): the
  `pnpm audit:optimizer` gate — feeds every page's mounted slots plus
  `reports/traces/` snapshots to `@mvp/optimizer`'s rule engine and writes
  `reports/optimization-findings.*`. Consult when investigating its findings
  or wiring trace-based optimization rules.
- [tools/release-tools/AGENT.md](tools/release-tools/AGENT.md): the pure
  logic behind the release/DevX CLIs — the unit dependency graph
  (`buildUnitGraph`/`queryRegistry`), graph-aware affected detection
  (changed paths → deployables, narrow-vs-GLOBAL), compose smoke checks, and
  mount-time layout advisories. Consult before touching blast-radius,
  smoke, or graph-query tooling.
- [tools/runtime-gate/AGENT.md](tools/runtime-gate/AGENT.md): the
  `pnpm verify:runtime` evaluator (not a workspace package) — pure
  `evaluateRuntime` turning browser observations into hydration / React-#418
  / asset-404 / layout-void / overflow / interaction checks. Consult before
  reasoning about the runtime/visual gate `pnpm verify` cannot see.
- [tools/server-client-boundary-check/AGENT.md](tools/server-client-boundary-check/AGENT.md):
  the `pnpm audit:boundary` gate — browser globals in server files,
  server→client-module imports (with the Next local-island exception),
  oversized client components, and `page/layout` `"use client"` warnings.
  Consult before moving code across the server/client boundary.
